sections.Profile:
"Trigger" is a Western-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Exhibit Supply Company in January 1951. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, and three passive bumpers.

- Manufacturer: Exhibit Supply Company
- Years made: 1951
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Wood Rail, Horses, Original Theme
